artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let p be an odd prime. Define the following standard objects:
- Binomial coefficients C(n,k) and Catalan numbers C_n = C(2n,n)/(n+1).
- Bernoulli numbers B_n and Euler numbers E_n, with E_n(x) the Euler polynomials.
- The harmonic-type sum H_m = sum_{j=1}^{m} 1/j.
- The Legendre/Jacobi symbol (·/·) (extended to prime powers as the Kronecker symbol), with the convention (a/p^0) = 1.
- The Fermat quotient q_p(2) = (2^{p-1}-1)/p.

Prove or disprove that for every odd prime p the following six congruences hold:

(1) For all a ∈ Z_{>0},
    sum_{k=0}^{p^a - 1} C(2k,k) C(4k,2k) / 64^k  ≡  ((-2/p^a) - (-2/p^{a-1})) · (3 p^2 / 16) · E_{p-3}(1)   (mod p^3).

(2) For all a ∈ Z_{>0},
    sum_{k=0}^{p^a - 1} C(2k,k) · C_{2k} / 64^k  ≡  ((-1/p^a) - (-1/p^{a-1})) · 3 p^2 · E_{p-3}   (mod p^3).

(3) sum_{k=1}^{p-1} C(2k,k) C(4k,2k) / (k · 64^k)  ≡  -3 H_{(p-1)/2} + (7/4) p^2 B_{p-3}   (mod p^3).

(4) sum_{k=1}^{(p-1)/2} C(2k,k) C(4k,2k) / (k · 64^k)  ≡  -3 H_{(p-1)/2} - 2 (-1/p) p E_{p-3}   (mod p^2).

(5) p · sum_{k=1}^{(p-1)/2} 64^k / ( k^3 · C(2k,k) · C(4k,2k) )  ≡  32 (-1/p) E_{p-3}   (mod p).

(6) p · sum_{k=1}^{(p-1)/2} 64^k / ( (2k-1) k^2 · C(2k,k) · C(4k,2k) )  ≡  16 ( p E_{p-3} - (-1/p) q_p(2) )   (mod p^2).
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a published proof resolving all six congruences in this conjecture. Some related supercongruences for sums involving C(2k,k)C(4k,2k)/64^k have been studied (e.g., by Z.-W. Sun and collaborators), but explicit verification that this entire conjecture is fully proved was not located, and it appears to remain open or only partially resolved.
